newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei likely to keep rising towards 18,500.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei likely to keep rising towards 18,500.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key index is expected to move up towards 18,500 on Monday, as gains for four consecutive trading days are likely to encourage further short-covering in strapped financial sectors, brokers said.
But any recovery in the index may slow near the 18,500 barrier because investors are eager to take profits above 18,000, they said.
On Friday, the 225-share Nikkei average climbed 258.73 points or 1.43 percent to end at 18,352.14. June Nikkei futures jumped 320 points to 18,400.
"Short-covering will continue to push up the Nikkei 225," said Yasuo Ueki, general manager of equities operations at Nikko Securities Co Ltd.
"But investors will take profits at a level close to 18,500," he said.
Brokers also said investors had started to look at a wider range of sectors.
"People have started to buy lower-priced stocks (in steel and chemicals), after having bought major blue-chip issues," said a broker at a medium-sized securities house.
